## Description / الوصف

Please provide a summary of the change and which issue it fixes.
يرجى تقديم ملخص للتغييرات والمشكلة أو الميزة التي يعالجها هذا الطلب.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change / نوع التغيير

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding a format or extractor)
- [ ] Refactoring / Architecture improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance optimization

## Checklist / قائمة التحقق

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style and guidelines (English code/comments, Arabic UI).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed (`pytest tests`).
- [ ] No personal or sensitive data is included in test fixtures.
